name: Low-passed wash
says: A seven-and-a-half-second hall and half-note echoes feeding it, the whole return low-passed at 1.7 kHz: the chord dissolves into a dark wash.

provenance.note: Self-written for the keys lab: a candidate for his pick, read by no part yet.
